exactSign: gr contains +epsilon*partial_T beta-ci*N beta; selected pre-Haar maximal Wrz leg has -epsilon^4/ci

linearScalarProjection.inverse: For every fixed original slow point the registered infinite N^-1 P_perp has zero normalized Haar mean.
linearScalarProjection.shift: For each radial binder the original common-Y map is translation by (Phi(r)-Phi(R))*vr, so normalized Haar is unchanged.
linearScalarProjection.T1: Fubini kills each r-weighted inverse integral separately; multiplication by cutoff, inverse ci and inverse R preserves the zero mean.
linearScalarProjection.slow: Derivative of this pointwise zero identity in Z,T is zero. T0/T1 cutoffs, all slow prefactors and physical normalization remain present before Haar.
linearScalarProjection.limits: Active whole radial endpoints sqrt(Xa) and 2*sqrt(Xb) are actually fixed. Leibniz terms for a moving generic endpoint also vanish for this pointwise-zero projected integrand.
linearScalarProjection.P0_ZZT: zero from the entire isolated linear epsilon*partial_T beta term, including every lower cutoff product term and the highest Z^5 T^2 Wrz term
linearScalarProjection.Jz0_ZZT: same weighted Haar(gr) identity with R^2 and factor -1/2; independently the flux branch contains gamma, gamma^2, Wzz and no beta time term; its linear 2*G0*gamma projects to zero
linearScalarProjection.gamma: gamma=(partial_R+aL+1/R) psi. Radial differentiation, the integral of the constant vector field L on the torus and multiplication by 1/R preserve zero Haar.

negativeControl: An inverse may output cos(2*pi*Y0) from its N derivative. Its Haar mean is zero, its square has Haar mean 1/2, so the original gamma^2/v^2/beta^2 product rule cannot be discarded.
remaining: genuine nonlinear Temporal products through their own directional source joins and inverse bounds
initial covariance, direct moment terms and all later stages
